ordered_branches.explanation: Reads GENERIC_CONFIG_DETAIL by fixed record type/transaction type; preserves non-NULL caller activation but always attempts upload flag lookup. Reads work zone by location+warehouse and normalizes NULL internal-container number to0. Two enabled activation values permit a wide TRANSACTION_HISTORY insert with caller before/after quantities, references and second-rounded UTC times; upload batch is NULL for two config values, fixed sentinel otherwise. Captures @@IDENTITY, which can be affected by trigger identity inserts, rather than SCOPE_IDENTITY. For positive identity adds feature-gated non-NULL catch weight/UM attributes, then serial-argument attributes. If serial attributes were inserted, counts DISTINCT serial GROUP_ID and may raise18 when nonzero count differs from quantity for a fixed transaction type with unchanged suspense quantity. If none inserted, a fixed location-class/transaction-type/changed-onhand branch looks up item tracking (specific OR generic company can yield multiple scalar rows); tracking7 requires a parseable reference with cycle-count requests or raises18. Finally adds nonzero location-attribute ID, but checks stale @error instead of capturing that final INSERT error.
